milestones.skill: Nether Step: Recall Shadows / Command Fallen
milestones.note: Respec (drop Hellion Sting/Sigil); Command Fallen grants gigantic resource generation via Fallen Rush.

strategy: Position your Greater Demon within enemy packs to deliver double circular AoE hits via Dread Claws, using Hellion Sting's Eviscerate upgrade for concentrated elite/boss burst damage. Progress through War Plans activities on Hard difficulty or higher once comfortable with clear speed.

paragon.note: Rank glyphs progressively through Pit runs. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
